Interestingly, I've noticed that your strategic approach also aligns with supporting your own political career, which could provide additional motivation and drive. Leveraging your extensive network and consulting experience will undoubtedly enhance your influence. Additionally, the transition from political consulting to environmental advocacy could open new avenues and perspectives. Have you considered how this shift might impact your approach to campaign strategies?
